visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a red box labeled with gold characters, containing yellow ritual paper bundles tied with red ribbons. (2) A man in his 20s or 30s, wearing a gray knit beanie and a black puffer jacket, holds a large red box and smiles broadly at the camera in a bustling outdoor environment with other people in the background. (3) A hand inserts a small red box labeled "發財金" (Wealth Money) into a vertical slot on a shelf. (4) Footage from a moving car shows a rainy, misty road winding through green hills with power lines visible overhead. (5) A wide shot reveals the Shiding Wulu Caishen Temple, a multi-story traditional Chinese building with orange-yellow tiled roofs and red pillars. (6) Inside, various offerings including incense, gold paper ingots, and red trays with meat and eggs are shown on long tables. (7) The man points to his thumb, which is covered in red ink, and presses it onto a yellow ritual document. (8) Handfuls of yellow spirit money are tossed into a stone furnace with bright, flickering orange flames. (9) The man washes his hands in a golden basin and then tosses a coin toward a stone fountain featuring a giant coin and a dragon mural; he claps and cheers when it hits. (10) Red crescent-shaped divination blocks are shown hitting the speckled tile floor. (11) Trays of red string bracelets and small gold tiger charms are displayed near a sign.

(5) [Subtitle]: 加薪又升官. (6) [Subtitle]: 我終於找到時間. [Slogan]: 每包150元. (7) [Subtitle]: 求貴人 求財運 總共1500元. (8) [Subtitle]: 先在單子上寫下名字. (9) [Subtitle]: 接著男左女右用大拇指蓋上騎縫章. (10) [Subtitle]: 把紙錢拿去香爐燒光光. (11) [Subtitle]: 接著可以拿零錢來換錢水這裡. (12) [Subtitle]: 敲響鑼就可以許願囉. [Variety]: (太驚喜). [Subtitle]: 進了!! (13) [Subtitle]: 如果有聖筊的話呢就可以. (14) [Slogan]: 財神爺招財吊飾每尊200元. (15) [Subtitle]: 記得要來還願還錢哦.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Travel -> Demonstration -> Result -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a travel vlog and cultural guide, detailing the specific steps and rituals required to pray for wealth at the Shiding Wulu Caishen Temple in Taiwan. The host demonstrates everything from buying ritual items and filling out documents to tossing coins for luck, with the goal of encouraging viewers to visit and seek their own financial fortune.
